authority_note: Scope is not owned by an implementation. LAW-OWNERSHIP.md assigns the laws to the BermLaunch lane; this document assigns what the product must and must not do, and constrains both repositories.
purpose: A finding about an out_of_scope item is not a blocker; close it by citation.
A capability not listed here is absent by decision, not missing by oversight.

components.name: Campaign constitution
components.does: Fixes cohort sizes and cumulative bps ranges, economic preset, observer policy and its hash, chain and domain, enrollment verifier path, roster and receipt schemas — before anything launches.
components.authority: Founder at authoring time; immutable thereafter, hash committed by the Distributor at deployment
must_fail: local registry overriding the on-chain commitment

components.name: Token launch
components.does: Creates the Bags token and binds the Distributor in the same transaction, so any failed invariant reverts the whole launch.
components.authority: Atomic Launch Controller only, by ruling
components.authority_rationale: permissionless binding would let an attacker pre-bind the Distributor to their own otherwise-valid token and permanently brick it with AlreadyBound

components.name: Distributor binding
components.does: Verifies sole-claimer at 10000 bps, token/curve/pool existence, WETH/hook/pool/curve match, no authority collision, non-zero beacon and implementation; snapshots Bags authority; sets launchBound.
components.authority: launchBinder only; one-shot, zero unbind or rebind paths (verified)
not_in_scope: binding a token not created by the Controller

components.name: Creator residual
not_in_scope: drawing against the community 6000 bps under any condition, including an unfilled cohort

components.name: Enrollment
components.does: Supporter signs one event binding campaign, mode, npub, EVM destination and proof of control. Two doors: existing signer short-circuits; otherwise generate a key and take the portable encrypted file.
must_fail: proof recovering to a different address
proof made for another mode or campaign
any address entering a roster without proof of control
components.note: the legacy_roster_wallet_v0 class is permanently out of scope, not merely fixed

components.name: Observation and ordering
components.does: Establishes the canonical enrollment on rebinding, using signed observation receipts from a constitution-named observer, with a per-cohort finalization cutoff.
must_fail: caller-supplied observation accepted without receipt verification
empty or absent observer policy treated as permissive
receipt id accepted rather than recomputed
components.disclosed_cost: the observer is a trusted party and belongs in SOVEREIGNTY.md at the same rank as the Bags rows

components.name: Cohort snapshot and roster
components.does: Membership from published snapshot differences; compiles verified enrollments into a canonical roster with cumulative weight ranges summing to exactly the whole.
must_fail: a member with no verified enrollment reaching a production roster
a roster compiled from normalized caller objects rather than raw evidence

components.name: Finalization and seal
components.does: Publishes one root per cohort with non-zero evidence hashes; sealRoots permanently retires the finalizer.
components.authority: rootFinalizer — temporary and disclosed, existing because GRADUATION and FOMO members cannot exist before they do; cannot move money, change economics, or alter a root already set
must_fail: evidence manifest not binding the constitution hash

components.name: Fee intake
components.does: Pulls fees from the Bags fee share and accounts for direct transfers so value arriving outside the expected path is credited rather than stranded.
not_in_scope: any admin path to value that has reached the contract

components.name: Graduation
components.does: Verifies graduation against on-chain state and opens the buyback gate.
must_fail: NotGraduated when verified state does not support it

components.name: Buyback claim
components.does: Supporter proves membership by Merkle proof and converts accumulated entitlement into the launched token via a fixed route, with slippage and deadline protection.
components.authority: the supporter with their own EVM key; no account, no approval, no requirement that our website is reachable
must_fail: failed swap must roll back atomically
not_in_scope: any route other than the committed one

components.name: Trust and Verify
components.does: Publishes constitution hash, roots, evidence manifests, cutoffs, economics, Bags upstream authority snapshot and per-member evidence status.
components.authority_boundary: PUBLISHER_AND_DISCLOSURE_ONLY — does not emit an independent recomputation verdict; only BL-13 may
must_fail: any affirmative status rendered from missing, partial, mock or asserted evidence
components.rule: absence renders as UNVERIFIED, visibly and loudly

components.name: Campaign explorer
components.does: Independently rebuilds roster and root from published evidence; reports four orthogonal verdicts: root recomputation, destination-proof coverage, per-member binding status, finalizable-under-current-law.
must_fail: a reproduced root implying proven destination control
importing the production verifier as its engine rather than cross-testing against frozen vectors

components.name: The supporter's post
components.does: A signed card showing cohort, slot, share and a verify link. Publishing to Nostr is a signature; opening the X composer is an intent; the two are never conflated.

out_of_scope_v1.reason: every address needs a control proof

out_of_scope_v1.item: a claim window, sweep, or expiry

out_of_scope_v1.reason: an unfilled cohort is a smaller cohort
a purchasable pocket separates the payout from the person by design, turning a supporter cohort into a pre-sale; also the property that changes the legal shape
out_of_scope_v1.roadmap_shape: credit (who was there — in the sealed root, never transferable) separated from claim (who collects — a layer above, optionally transferable)
out_of_scope_v1.precondition: legal advice before build, because transferability is the specific feature that moves it

out_of_scope_v1.reason: roadmap, nice-to-have — Bags already ships it
out_of_scope_v1.evidence: Bags partnered with DexScreener to build 'DEX Boosts on Bags', a fee sharing app that buys boosts automatically, plus a 'Pay DEX' app
law_that_survives_regardless: a boost pocket cannot be a second Bags claimer — BL-03 requires this Distributor as sole claimer at 10000 bps; a second claimer reverts with InvalidLaunchBinding, so Bags' own DEX apps and our Distributor are mutually exclusive on the same token
nothing is ever paid for out of the community's 6000 bps — not marketing, listings, boosts, or our own costs; permitted sources are the operating fee and the creator's residual
not_blocked_by_this: a creator-signed statement that the metadata held by BermLaunch IS the dex metadata
a website-fallback link pointing at the BermLaunch token page, which carries the metadata and the Nostr-signed community messages
out_of_scope_v1.governing_invariant: 2 — 'submitted' is not 'listed' until a fetch confirms it

out_of_scope_v1.item: paying for anything from community bps
out_of_scope_v1.reason: the split is the supporters', full stop
out_of_scope_v1.restates: BL-04, so it cannot be re-argued as an exception for a good cause

invariants: No address enters a payout list without proof of control.
Nothing renders as verified that was not verified. Absence is UNVERIFIED.
Entitlement does not expire and cannot be swept.
Claiming never requires our website, our account, or our permission.
revision_rule: Scope changes by editing this document and incrementing the version, with the reason recorded. It does not change by an implementation adding a capability, a review finding an omission, or a conversation reaching a conclusion. A capability that appears in code but not here is out of scope and must be removed or added here first.

added the DEX visibility pocket (listing then boosts) to out_of_scope, ruled roadmap/nice-to-have because Bags already ships it; added the explicit community-bps funding prohibition
revision_history.note: both items were already absent. This records the ruling and the funding-source constraint so neither is re-litigated.
